description: System monitoring capabilities to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks are not implemented.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing intrusion detection systems (IDS), absent security information and event management (SIEM) tools, lack of network monitoring capabilities, and no monitoring device deployment strategy.
